faqs.question: What do I need to open an account?
faqs.answer: A valid national ID or passport and proof of residence. Companies, schools and churches also bring their registration documents and a signatory resolution. Start with the account opening form and a relationship manager confirms the exact list for the account you choose.

faqs.question: Can I open an account from outside Zimbabwe?
faqs.answer: Yes. The diaspora banking page explains how to open and run a CBZ Bank account from abroad, and the same account opening form works wherever you live.

faqs.question: How do I get CBZ Touch?
faqs.answer: Download CBZ Touch from the App Store or Google Play and register with your CBZ Bank account or wallet. It is zero-rated, so it uses no data on local networks.

faqs.question: How long does a loan application take?
faqs.answer: Send the loan application form with what you are financing and your income. A lending officer contacts you within two working days with what you qualify for and the documents needed.

faqs.question: Who do I speak to about business banking?
faqs.answer: Use the account opening form for a corporate, school or church account, or ask for a call back and choose Business banking. A relationship manager calls you.

productsNote: Requirements, features and benefits are those set out in the Retail Banking Product Manual. Lending is subject to credit assessment, and interest rates are subject to change; confirm current terms before you apply.
about: CBZ Bank is the Group’s commercial bank. It runs everyday transactional and savings accounts, foreign currency accounts, cards, and personal, school fees and business lending, alongside mortgages, internet banking, CBZ Touch and merchant point of sale, for individuals, companies, schools, churches and Zimbabweans abroad.
